ajudaPirata: There are pirates on board. At night, pirates throw someone overboard, the Lookout searches someone, the Doctor protects someone and sailors keep watch (with N on the same person, they learn if that person left their cabin). By day, talk and vote who walks the plank. {segurar} Winning team +1000; alive at the end +300.

ajudaMaquinas: Everyone is a robot. The Crew fixes the engine; the Mutineers sabotage and hide the Rogue AI. Each round the Commander picks a Pilot and everyone votes. If approved, the Commander discards 1 of 3 cards and the Pilot picks 1 of 2. 3 rejected governments in a row = the top card goes in. Sabotages give the Commander powers. {segurar} Winning team +1000; winning AI +500; +100 per card of your colour enacted with you in government.

rdInfoRegras: There are two rooms and two teams: the Court 🔵 protects the King and the Rebels 🔴 help the Dragon. At midnight the Dragon turns into a dragon and scorches everyone in their room. If the King is there, the Rebels win; if not, the Court wins. Each round, talk and show your colour or card to whoever you like. At the end of the round, each leader sends hostages to the other room. {segurar}
rdInfoCasa: Nobody has to show anything, and no peeking at other phones. The leader doesn't have to explain. No talking to the other room, except leaders during the swap.
rdInfoPontos: Winning team +1000; winning King/Dragon +500; extra role done +500; neutral done +1000.
ajudaRei: Two rooms, two teams, hostage swaps. At midnight the Dragon scorches their room: if the King is there, the Rebels win. {segurar}
